title: Astrid's Gambling Cubes
description: Ready To Risk it All, Test Your Luck With These Cubes, Spawns Items, Mobs And More
body:
**Whats Added**,
 **Gambling Cube**,
 **Unlucky Gambling Cube**,
 **Lucky Gambling Cube**

You Might Ask What Are Gambling Cubes?  
Well Gambing Cubes Are Just Like Lucky Blocks, Whats The Difference? 
GLAD YOU ASKED 
These Gambling Cubes has 4 different percent chances for things to happen (besides from the normal one with only 3 percent chances)  
And Each Block Has A Different Percent Chance with it
The Normal Gambling Cube has 
40% good 
35% bad
25% weird/neutral
The Unlucky Gambling Cube Has
70% bad
20% troll/funny bad
8% disaster
2% ironic good
And
The Lucky Gambling Cube Has
65% normal good rewards
25% jackpot rewards
8% funny lucky
2% legendary
And Another Difference Is These Gambling Cubes Have COBBLEMON COMPATIBLLITY
When You Have Cobblemon Installed with Gambling Cubes you have these Chances
50% Pokémon-related rewards
25% items (balls, healing, stones)
15% structures/events
8% rare Pokémon
2% legendary
With The Added 70/30 of Normal and Cobblemon Stuff, It Only Applies to The Normal Gambing Cube
 HAVE FUN
